notes.title: Raid matchmaking explained
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32795295/b793f07e2eeb950f3b2613397cb82a344c63c6f2.png[/img]

We’ve heard that some of you are a little bit confused by how the new queue system for raids works. Despair no longer, we are here to explain it!

[list] 
[*]If you select raid and press play, the matchmaking system will first look if there are any ongoing Raid matches with open slots. If there are any, you will join. 
[*]If there are no ongoing raid matches, the matchmaking system will next look for Raid lobbies with open slots. If there are any Raid lobbies, you will join. 
[*]If there aren’t, you will instead join ongoing Drill matches with open slots. 
[*]If those don’t exist either, you will join a Drill lobbies with open slots. 
[*]And if everything fails and none of the above is possible, the matchmaking system will just create a new Drill lobby and put you in there. 
[/list]
So, to sum it up, the priorities after choosing to play raid mode are:

Ongoing Raid -> Raid lobby -> Ongoing Drill match -> Drill match lobby -> New drill match lobby

We are aware that, due to these changes, it’s currently a bit difficult to join a raid match. Don’t worry; it’s not going to stay that way. The queue changes were just the first step, not the last!

notes.title: The new matchmaking system has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32795295/dee72e56676bd3bb2ab0dbf3ed3cba1f7982d6bd.jpg[/img]

The feedback you gave us for the matchmaking system was top notch. It's all been implemented directly into the game - you're the boss!


So here's what will happen:
[list]
[*]Enlist for 'Drill Combat' and you will get a drill match instead of a raid match - or a washing machine... wait, what?
[*]We’ve also increased the amount of Dollen you receive from Drill matches drastically, in order to fit the new queue system!
[*]But the raids haven't just fallen into oblivion. If you enlist for a raid, then you'll still get into a raid match. If we can't find an ongoing game or an open lobby for you, then you'll join a drill lobby/match.
[/list]

Oh, and there's more:
[list]
[*]The mouse-sensitivity scale has changed. We've reduced the max. sensitivity, and the default has increased from 10 to 50 - If you changed your mouse sensitivity before this update, make sure you check on it before your next match.
[*]The matchmaking system has changed! One sec, I'm sure I wrote that down...
[*]From now on you'll automatically spawn after 20 seconds
[/list]

Bugs, pesky creatures. We have successfully exterminated the following bugs:
[list]
Your firearms are no longer invisible to you in first person mode while you're wearing a football outfit.
[/list]

Don't worry, we're keeping an eye on the bugs you've already reported, and we're working on finishing them off.



Now, back to the battlefield!

notes.title: Strategy and Explosions: The Raid Mode
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32795295/a6b6ebf8b7f6121a878d549f236c9bdd41b0a531.png[/img]

It’s not the first time you click-shoot your way through hordes of heavily armed soldiers, right? So your mission in the raid mode should be clear: Kill all your enemies. Or blow them up. 

It is as simple as it sounds: [b]Join one of two opposing teams, raid their base and defend your own.[/b]

Exterminate your opponents so often that their score hits zero or find their base and place a timed bomb. And then give them a warm reception in your own beautifully customized home base – welcome to the bullet storm fortress!

[h1][b]Locate. Raid. Defend. Repeat.[/b][/h1]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=maUQwU9qR7A]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=maUQwU9qR7A[/url]
And if you find something we could handle different in this mode: [b]Tell us! We want your feedback![/b]

notes.title: Improving game and service (plus a gift for you)!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32795295/dee72e56676bd3bb2ab0dbf3ed3cba1f7982d6bd.jpg[/img]

Hey guys,

the first week of RockShot lays behind us and it was a hell of a ride! It began with some tough luck: Server crashes on the first day resulted in a bad user experience and corresponding reviews. We just started in the Early Access phase, so improving RockShot is an ongoing process and we are committed to do so.

We are really grateful for the amount of feedback you provided us with, we are listening to all of you and we want to strongly highlight how important your feedback is for us.

In the last [url=https://forum.rockshot.gameforge.com/forum/thread/125-maintenance-12-6-2018/]patch note[/url] you may have noticed that most of the changes came from what we gathered up from Steam and our Board. These changes are just a first step, as we are working on a whole set of future features, fixes and balancements. We want to be as transparent as possible with you, so please stay tuned, as we will share our next steps and things we are currently working on over the course of the next days.

Additionally, we are looking at improving the current queueing times in match making.

As thanksgiving for your effort on sharing with us your opinion and suggestions we decided to deliver a little gift to all of you:

- 3x Red Dragon Gacha Tickets
- 3x Army Ninja Gacha Tickets
- 3x Chimera Gacha Tickets

Please note that you'll receive the item automatically as soon as you login. We wish you the best of luck with the Gachas


The RockShot Team
